name: D.C. III ~Da Capo III~ Dream Days
original_name: D.C.Ⅲ DreamDays～ダ・カーポⅢ～ドリームデイズ
source:
A Fandisc of [url=https://vndb.org/v13105]Platinum Partner[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/v17743]With You[/url]. Featuring the stories told on the modern day Hatsunejima alongside with stories of the Heroines on the Kazami Academy episode of the D.C.III series.

It is composed of seven episodes, which features the five heroines plus Mikoto and Sumomo, and the return of most of the [url=https://vndb.org/v266/chars]D.C.II[/url] cast, including Otome, Yume, Nanaka, Koko, Anzu, Akane, and Aisia.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/09/28/september-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
